audience: agencies and service businesses that manage clients, leads and projects in SuiteDash

useCases.title: Find contacts created lately and see who is still a lead
useCases.text: The AI lists CRM contacts filtered by creation time with name, role, tags and companies. You can tell leads from clients.

useCases.title: See everything about a company
useCases.text: The AI opens a company with its primary contact, category, tags, address and custom fields, or lists companies by creation time.

useCases.title: Check projects, their status and dates
useCases.text: The AI lists projects with status, start and end dates and due time, and opens one with client, team and economics. You see which projects end soon.

useCases.title: Create a lead, client or company
useCases.text: The AI creates a CRM contact with a role such as Lead or Client, or a company. It can link a contact to a company by name and read the field schema first.

useCases.title: Update a contact, company or project
useCases.text: The AI changes fields of an existing contact, company or project. Only the fields you pass change, and tags or custom fields you pass replace the old values.

useCases.title: Subscribe people to marketing audiences
useCases.text: The AI subscribes people, by email, to marketing audiences by numeric audience id. This enrolls real people in email marketing, so do it only for people who agreed.
